# `aitbc blockchain create`

Create a new chain from a JSON configuration file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain create [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config-file` | path | — | yes | The Config file. |
| `--node` | text | — | no | Target node for chain creation |
| `--dry-run` | flag | `false` | no | Show what would be created without actually creating |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain create --config-file <config_file>
```
